@package haskell-obj-c
@version 0.1.0.0


-- | Autorelease pool management via the Objective-C runtime.
module ObjC.Runtime.AutoreleasePool

-- | Push a new autorelease pool. Returns a token to pass to
--   <a>objc_autoreleasePoolPop</a>.
objc_autoreleasePoolPush :: IO (Ptr ())

-- | Pop an autorelease pool (releasing all autoreleased objects since the
--   corresponding push).
objc_autoreleasePoolPop :: Ptr () -> IO ()

-- | Execute an action inside an autorelease pool. The pool is drained
--   after the action completes (or on exception).
withAutoreleasePool :: IO a -> IO a


-- | Dynamic framework loading via <tt>dlopen</tt>.
--   
--   Use this to load macOS frameworks at runtime that are not linked at
--   compile time, making their Objective-C classes available to
--   <tt>objc_getClass</tt> and the rest of the runtime.
module ObjC.Runtime.Framework

-- | Load a macOS framework by name. Looks for it in
--   <tt>/System/Library/Frameworks/&lt;name&gt;.framework/&lt;name&gt;</tt>.
--   
--   Throws an <a>IOError</a> if loading fails.
--   
--   After loading, all Objective-C classes defined by the framework become
--   available to <tt>objc_getClass</tt> and friends.
loadFramework :: String -> IO ()

-- | Load a framework (or any dynamic library) by full path.
--   
--   Throws an <a>IOError</a> if loading fails.
loadFrameworkAt :: String -> IO ()


-- | Core types for the Objective-C runtime.
--   
--   These are opaque pointer wrappers corresponding to the types defined
--   in <tt>&lt;objc/runtime.h&gt;</tt> and <tt>&lt;objc/objc.h&gt;</tt>.
--   
--   The two main object types are:
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li><a>RawId</a> — a raw, unmanaged <tt>id</tt> pointer for low-level
--   FFI plumbing.</li>
--   <li><tt><a>Id</a> a</tt> — a managed, phantom-typed <a>ForeignPtr</a>
--   whose finalizer calls <tt>-[obj release]</tt> when the Haskell GC
--   collects it.</li>
--   </ul>
module ObjC.Runtime.Types

-- | Phantom type for <tt>id</tt> (Objective-C object pointer).
data ObjCObject

-- | A raw Objective-C object pointer (<tt>id</tt>).
--   
--   This is the unmanaged, untyped pointer used internally by
--   <tt>sendRawMsg</tt>, <a>ObjCSuper</a>, and the C FFI. Most user code
--   should use <tt><a>Id</a> a</tt> instead.
newtype RawId
RawId :: Ptr ObjCObject -> RawId
[unRawId] :: RawId -> Ptr ObjCObject

-- | The nil object (raw).
nilRawId :: RawId

-- | A managed, phantom-typed Objective-C object pointer.
--   
--   Internally wraps a <a>ForeignPtr</a> whose finalizer sends <tt>-[obj
--   release]</tt> when the Haskell GC collects it.
--   
--   The phantom type <tt>a</tt> distinguishes different ObjC class types
--   at the Haskell level (e.g., <tt>Id NSString</tt> vs <tt>Id
--   NSArray</tt>).
--   
--   The phantom type has a <b>nominal</b> role, which means GHC's
--   <tt>coerce</tt> (from <a>Data.Coerce</a>) <b>cannot</b> convert
--   between <tt>Id a</tt> and <tt>Id b</tt>.
newtype Id a
Id :: ForeignPtr ObjCObject -> Id a
[idForeignPtr] :: Id a -> ForeignPtr ObjCObject

-- | Base type class for all Objective-C objects.
--   
--   Provides raw pointer extraction, safe scoped access, and static class
--   lookup. Generated bindings provide instances for each ObjC class.
--   
--   The superclass chain for generated type classes is:
--   
--   <pre>
--   IsObjCObject            -- toRawId, withObjCPtr, staticClass
--     |-- IsNSObject         -- toNSObject
--          |-- IsNSString    -- toNSString
--               |-- ...
--   </pre>
class IsObjCObject a

-- | Extract the raw pointer. The caller must ensure <tt>a</tt> stays alive
--   for the duration of use (prefer <a>withObjCPtr</a> instead).
toRawId :: IsObjCObject a => a -> RawId

-- | Safely extract the underlying pointer for the duration of a callback.
--   Keeps the managed object alive until <tt>f</tt> returns.
withObjCPtr :: IsObjCObject a => a -> (Ptr ObjCObject -> IO b) -> IO b

-- | Get the Objective-C <a>Class</a> corresponding to this Haskell type.
staticClass :: IsObjCObject a => Proxy a -> IO Class

-- | Zero-cost conversion between <a>Id</a> types.
--   
--   Used by generated type class instances (e.g., <tt>IsNSString</tt>) to
--   implement upcast methods. This is safe when used within generated code
--   that correctly encodes the ObjC class hierarchy; calling it directly
--   bypasses type safety.
unsafeCastId :: Id a -> Id b

-- | Wrap a <tt>+1</tt> (owned) return value. Attaches a release finalizer.
--   
--   Use for results of <tt>init</tt>, <tt>copy</tt>, <tt>new</tt>,
--   <tt>mutableCopy</tt> methods.
ownedObject :: Ptr ObjCObject -> IO (Id a)

-- | Wrap a <tt>+0</tt> (borrowed/autoreleased) return value. Retains it
--   first, then attaches a release finalizer.
--   
--   Use for results of most Objective-C methods (getters, factory methods
--   that don't start with init<i>copy</i>new/mutableCopy).
retainedObject :: Ptr ObjCObject -> IO (Id a)

-- | Wrap a pointer with no finalizer. Used for freshly <tt>alloc</tt>'d
--   objects that have not yet been <tt>init</tt>'d — the <tt>init</tt>
--   method will produce a properly managed <a>Id</a>.
unmanagedObject :: Ptr ObjCObject -> IO (Id a)

-- | The nil object as a managed <a>Id</a>.
--   
--   Wraps <a>nullPtr</a> in a <a>ForeignPtr</a> with no finalizer. Safe
--   because Objective-C's <tt>release(nil)</tt> is a no-op, and
--   <a>withForeignPtr</a> on it yields <a>nullPtr</a>.
--   
--   Useful for passing <tt>nil</tt> to typed API functions:
--   
--   <pre>
--   TV.setHeaderView tableView nilId   -- removes the header view
--   </pre>
nilId :: Id a

-- | Retain and autorelease an <a>Id</a>, returning the raw pointer.
--   
--   Follows the standard Objective-C <tt>+0</tt> return convention: the
--   object's retain count is bumped and then placed in the current
--   autorelease pool. This is the correct way to hand a Haskell-managed
--   <a>Id</a> back to Objective-C as a <tt>+0</tt> return value (e.g.,
--   from delegate callbacks).
--   
--   <pre>
--   returnId :: Id a -&gt; IO RawId
--   returnId obj = retainAutorelease obj
--   </pre>
retainAutorelease :: Id a -> IO RawId

-- | Extract the raw pointer from an <a>Id</a>. Unsafe: the pointer is only
--   valid as long as the <a>ForeignPtr</a> is alive. Intended for
--   generated <a>IsObjCObject</a> instances.
idToRawId :: Id a -> RawId

-- | Bracket-style access to the raw pointer inside an <a>Id</a>. Keeps the
--   <a>ForeignPtr</a> alive for the duration of <tt>f</tt>. Intended for
--   generated <a>IsObjCObject</a> instances.
withIdObjCPtr :: Id a -> (Ptr ObjCObject -> IO b) -> IO b

-- | Phantom type for <tt>Class</tt>.
data ObjCClass

-- | An Objective-C class pointer (<tt>Class</tt>).
newtype Class
Class :: Ptr ObjCClass -> Class
[unClass] :: Class -> Ptr ObjCClass

-- | Nil class.
nilClass :: Class

-- | Phantom type for <tt>SEL</tt>.
data ObjCSel

-- | An Objective-C selector (<tt>SEL</tt>), optionally carrying phantom
--   type information about the method's parameter types and return type.
--   
--   The phantom parameters exist for documentation and future type-safe
--   dispatch; they do not affect runtime representation.
newtype Selector (args :: [Type]) ret
Selector :: Ptr ObjCSel -> Selector (args :: [Type]) ret
[unSelector] :: Selector (args :: [Type]) ret -> Ptr ObjCSel

-- | Untyped selector alias. Use this in contexts where the selector's
--   method signature is unknown or irrelevant (FFI, runtime
--   introspection).
type Sel = Selector '[] :: [Type] ()

-- | Nil selector.
nilSelector :: Sel

-- | Phantom type for <tt>Method</tt>.
data ObjCMethod

-- | An Objective-C method (<tt>Method</tt>).
newtype Method
Method :: Ptr ObjCMethod -> Method
[unMethod] :: Method -> Ptr ObjCMethod

-- | Phantom type for <tt>Ivar</tt>.
data ObjCIvar

-- | An Objective-C instance variable (<tt>Ivar</tt>).
newtype Ivar
Ivar :: Ptr ObjCIvar -> Ivar
[unIvar] :: Ivar -> Ptr ObjCIvar

-- | Phantom type for <tt>Category</tt>.
data ObjCCategory

-- | An Objective-C category (<tt>Category</tt>).
newtype Category
Category :: Ptr ObjCCategory -> Category
[unCategory] :: Category -> Ptr ObjCCategory

-- | Phantom type for <tt>objc_property_t</tt>.
data ObjCPropertyOpaque

-- | An Objective-C declared property (<tt>objc_property_t</tt>).
newtype ObjCProperty
ObjCProperty :: Ptr ObjCPropertyOpaque -> ObjCProperty
[unObjCProperty] :: ObjCProperty -> Ptr ObjCPropertyOpaque

-- | Phantom type for <tt>Protocol</tt>.
data ObjCProtocol

-- | An Objective-C protocol (<tt>Protocol *</tt>).
newtype Protocol
Protocol :: Ptr ObjCProtocol -> Protocol
[unProtocol] :: Protocol -> Ptr ObjCProtocol

-- | An Objective-C method implementation pointer (<tt>IMP</tt>).
newtype IMP
IMP :: FunPtr (Ptr ObjCObject -> Ptr ObjCSel -> IO (Ptr ObjCObject)) -> IMP
[unIMP] :: IMP -> FunPtr (Ptr ObjCObject -> Ptr ObjCSel -> IO (Ptr ObjCObject))

-- | Objective-C <tt>BOOL</tt> type. On modern Apple platforms this is
--   <tt>_Bool</tt> (CBool).
newtype ObjCBool
ObjCBool :: CBool -> ObjCBool
[unObjCBool] :: ObjCBool -> CBool
objcTrue :: ObjCBool
objcFalse :: ObjCBool
fromObjCBool :: ObjCBool -> Bool
toObjCBool :: Bool -> ObjCBool

-- | <tt>struct objc_method_description</tt> — describes a method's
--   selector and type encoding.
data ObjCMethodDescription
ObjCMethodDescription :: Sel -> CString -> ObjCMethodDescription
[methodDescName] :: ObjCMethodDescription -> Sel
[methodDescTypes] :: ObjCMethodDescription -> CString

-- | <tt>objc_property_attribute_t</tt> — a property attribute name/value
--   pair.
data ObjCPropertyAttribute
ObjCPropertyAttribute :: CString -> CString -> ObjCPropertyAttribute
[propertyAttrName] :: ObjCPropertyAttribute -> CString
[propertyAttrValue] :: ObjCPropertyAttribute -> CString

-- | Policy for <tt>objc_setAssociatedObject</tt>.
newtype ObjCAssociationPolicy
ObjCAssociationPolicy :: CUIntPtr -> ObjCAssociationPolicy
pattern OBJC_ASSOCIATION_ASSIGN :: ObjCAssociationPolicy
pattern OBJC_ASSOCIATION_RETAIN_NONATOMIC :: ObjCAssociationPolicy
pattern OBJC_ASSOCIATION_COPY_NONATOMIC :: ObjCAssociationPolicy
pattern OBJC_ASSOCIATION_RETAIN :: ObjCAssociationPolicy
pattern OBJC_ASSOCIATION_COPY :: ObjCAssociationPolicy

-- | <tt>struct objc_super</tt> — used for <tt>objc_msgSendSuper</tt>.
data ObjCSuper
ObjCSuper :: RawId -> Class -> ObjCSuper
[superReceiver] :: ObjCSuper -> RawId
[superSuperclass] :: ObjCSuper -> Class

-- | Type-level annotation for C <tt>const</tt>-qualified values.
--   
--   For example, <tt>Const (Ptr CChar)</tt> represents <tt>const char
--   *</tt>. Zero-cost newtype: use <a>Const</a> to wrap and <a>unConst</a>
--   to unwrap.
newtype Const a
Const :: a -> Const a
[unConst] :: Const a -> a

-- | Type-level annotation for C <tt>volatile</tt>-qualified values.
--   
--   For example, <tt>Volatile (Ptr CInt)</tt> represents <tt>volatile int
--   *</tt>. Zero-cost newtype: use <a>Volatile</a> to wrap and
--   <a>unVolatile</a> to unwrap.
newtype Volatile a
Volatile :: a -> Volatile a
[unVolatile] :: Volatile a -> a

-- | Check whether a bitmask value contains a specific flag.
--   
--   Intended for use with <tt>ViewPatterns</tt>:
--   
--   <pre>
--   {-# LANGUAGE ViewPatterns #-}
--   case mask of
--     (hasFlag NSWindowStyleMaskTitled -&gt; True) -&gt; ...
--   </pre>
hasFlag :: (Bits a, Eq a) => a -> a -> Bool

-- | Bindings to Objective-C selector functions from
--   <tt>&lt;objc/runtime.h&gt;</tt>.
module ObjC.Runtime.Selector

-- | Register (or look up) a selector by name. Maps a C string to a
--   <tt>Selector</tt>.
sel_registerName :: CString -> IO Sel

-- | Get the name of a selector as a C string.
sel_getName :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. Selector args ret -> IO CString

-- | Test whether two selectors are equal.
sel_isEqual :: forall (a1 :: [Type]) r1 (a2 :: [Type]) r2. Selector a1 r1 -> Selector a2 r2 -> IO Bool

-- | Create a selector from a Haskell <a>String</a>.
--   
--   The type parameters are phantom and inferred from the call site, so a
--   type annotation controls the selector's type signature:
--   
--   <pre>
--   sel :: Selector '[Id NSString] (IO Bool)
--   sel = mkSelector "validate:"
--   </pre>
--   
--   This is pure because <tt>sel_registerName</tt> is idempotent and
--   thread-safe: it always returns the same <tt>Selector</tt> pointer for
--   a given name.
mkSelector :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. String -> Selector args ret

-- | Get the name of a selector as a Haskell <a>String</a>.
selName :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. Selector args ret -> IO String

-- | Erase the phantom type parameters from a selector, producing an
--   untyped <a>Sel</a>.
--   
--   Useful for passing a typed action selector to functions like
--   <tt>setAction</tt> or <tt>buttonWithTitle_target_action</tt> that
--   expect <a>Sel</a>.
--   
--   <pre>
--   toggleSel :: Selector '[Id NSView] ()
--   toggleSel = mkSelector "toggle:"
--   
--   Ctrl.setAction button (asSel toggleSel)
--   </pre>
asSel :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. Selector args ret -> Sel


-- | Bindings to Objective-C protocol functions from
--   <tt>&lt;objc/runtime.h&gt;</tt>.
module ObjC.Runtime.Protocol

-- | Look up a protocol by name. Returns a null Protocol if not found.
objc_getProtocol :: CString -> IO Protocol

-- | Copy the list of all registered protocols.
objc_copyProtocolList :: IO [Protocol]

-- | Allocate a new protocol (not yet registered).
objc_allocateProtocol :: CString -> IO Protocol

-- | Register a previously allocated protocol, making it available to the
--   runtime.
objc_registerProtocol :: Protocol -> IO ()

-- | Add a method description to a protocol. <tt>isRequired</tt>: whether
--   the method is required. <tt>isInstanceMethod</tt>: whether it is an
--   instance method (vs class method).
protocol_addMethodDescription :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. Protocol -> Selector args ret -> CString -> Bool -> Bool -> IO ()

-- | Add a protocol that this protocol conforms to.
protocol_addProtocol :: Protocol -> Protocol -> IO ()

-- | Add a property to a protocol.
protocol_addProperty :: Protocol -> CString -> Ptr ObjCPropertyAttribute -> CUInt -> Bool -> Bool -> IO ()

-- | Get the name of a protocol.
protocol_getName :: Protocol -> IO CString

-- | Test whether two protocols are equal.
protocol_isEqual :: Protocol -> Protocol -> IO Bool

-- | Test whether a protocol conforms to another protocol.
protocol_conformsToProtocol :: Protocol -> Protocol -> IO Bool

-- | Copy the list of method descriptions in a protocol.
protocol_copyMethodDescriptionList :: Protocol -> Bool -> Bool -> IO [ObjCMethodDescription]

-- | Get a single method description from a protocol. Note: this function
--   is not available via direct FFI because it returns a struct by value.
--   Use <a>protocol_copyMethodDescriptionList</a> and filter instead.
protocol_getMethodDescription :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. Protocol -> Selector args ret -> Bool -> Bool -> IO (Maybe ObjCMethodDescription)

-- | Copy the list of properties declared by a protocol.
protocol_copyPropertyList :: Protocol -> IO [ObjCProperty]

-- | Get a property from a protocol by name.
protocol_getProperty :: Protocol -> CString -> Bool -> Bool -> IO ObjCProperty

-- | Copy the list of protocols adopted by a protocol.
protocol_copyProtocolList :: Protocol -> IO [Protocol]


-- | Bindings to Objective-C property introspection functions from
--   <tt>&lt;objc/runtime.h&gt;</tt>.
module ObjC.Runtime.Property

-- | Get the name of a property.
property_getName :: ObjCProperty -> IO CString

-- | Get the attribute string of a property.
property_getAttributes :: ObjCProperty -> IO CString

-- | Copy the list of property attributes. Returns a Haskell list; the C
--   array is freed automatically.
property_copyAttributeList :: ObjCProperty -> IO [ObjCPropertyAttribute]

-- | Copy the value for a named property attribute. The returned C string
--   must be freed by the caller with <a>free</a>.
property_copyAttributeValue :: ObjCProperty -> CString -> IO CString


-- | Dynamic Objective-C message sending via <tt>libffi</tt>.
--   
--   On ARM64, <tt>objc_msgSend</tt> is a trampoline whose calling
--   convention must match the target method exactly. We use
--   <tt>libffi</tt> to construct the correct call frame at runtime, given
--   the argument and return types.
--   
--   Usage example (sending <tt>length</tt> to an NSString):
--   
--   <pre>
--   len &lt;- sendMsg nsString lengthSel (retCULong) []
--   </pre>
module ObjC.Runtime.MsgSend

-- | Send a message to any <a>IsObjCObject</a> receiver.
--   
--   Uses <a>withObjCPtr</a> to keep the receiver alive for the duration of
--   the call.
sendMsg :: forall recv (args :: [Type]) ret a. IsObjCObject recv => recv -> Selector args ret -> RetType a -> [Arg] -> IO a

-- | Send a message that returns a floating-point value. On x86_64, this
--   uses <tt>objc_msgSend_fpret</tt>. On ARM64, identical to
--   <a>sendMsg</a>.
sendMsgFpret :: forall recv (args :: [Type]) ret a. IsObjCObject recv => recv -> Selector args ret -> RetType a -> [Arg] -> IO a

-- | Send a message that returns a struct. On x86_64, this uses
--   <tt>objc_msgSend_stret</tt>. On ARM64, identical to <a>sendMsg</a>.
sendMsgStret :: forall recv (args :: [Type]) ret a. IsObjCObject recv => recv -> Selector args ret -> RetType a -> [Arg] -> IO a

-- | Send a message using a raw <a>RawId</a> receiver. For low-level FFI
--   use.
sendRawMsg :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret a. RawId -> Selector args ret -> RetType a -> [Arg] -> IO a

-- | Raw variant of <a>sendMsgFpret</a>.
sendRawMsgFpret :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret a. RawId -> Selector args ret -> RetType a -> [Arg] -> IO a

-- | Raw variant of <a>sendMsgStret</a>.
sendRawMsgStret :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret a. RawId -> Selector args ret -> RetType a -> [Arg] -> IO a

-- | Send a message to an Objective-C class (class method).
sendClassMsg :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret a. Class -> Selector args ret -> RetType a -> [Arg] -> IO a

-- | Class method variant of <a>sendMsgFpret</a>.
sendClassMsgFpret :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret a. Class -> Selector args ret -> RetType a -> [Arg] -> IO a

-- | Class method variant of <a>sendMsgStret</a>.
sendClassMsgStret :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret a. Class -> Selector args ret -> RetType a -> [Arg] -> IO a

-- | Send a message to the superclass implementation.
--   
--   You must construct an <a>ObjCSuper</a> struct and pass a pointer to it
--   as the first argument. The selector is the second argument.
sendSuperMsg :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret a. ObjCSuper -> Selector args ret -> RetType a -> [Arg] -> IO a

-- | Function pointer to <tt>objc_msgSend</tt>.
objcMsgSendPtr :: FunPtr a

-- | Function pointer to <tt>objc_msgSendSuper</tt>.
objcMsgSendSuperPtr :: FunPtr a

-- | Function pointer to <tt>objc_msgSend_stret</tt> (or
--   <tt>objc_msgSend</tt> on ARM64).
objcMsgSendStretPtr :: FunPtr a

-- | Function pointer to <tt>objc_msgSend_fpret</tt> (or
--   <tt>objc_msgSend</tt> on ARM64).
objcMsgSendFpretPtr :: FunPtr a


-- | Bindings to Objective-C object instance functions from
--   <tt>&lt;objc/runtime.h&gt;</tt>, plus convenience helpers for the
--   fundamental <tt>+alloc</tt> / <tt>-init</tt> lifecycle.
module ObjC.Runtime.Object

-- | Send <tt>+[Class alloc]</tt> and return an unmanaged, typed <a>Id</a>.
--   
--   The returned object has <b>no finalizer</b> — it must be passed to an
--   <tt>init</tt> method (which returns a properly managed <a>Id</a>).
--   
--   The class is determined by the return type via <a>staticClass</a>. Use
--   with <tt>TypeApplications</tt> when the return type is ambiguous:
--   
--   <pre>
--   obj &lt;- alloc @NSWindow
--   </pre>
alloc :: IsObjCObject (Id a) => IO (Id a)

-- | Send <tt>-[obj init]</tt> — the plain <tt>NSObject</tt> initializer.
--   
--   Returns a properly managed <a>Id</a> with a release finalizer (the
--   init result is a +1 owned reference).
--   
--   The input object (typically from <a>alloc</a>) may differ from the
--   output due to class clusters; always use the returned value.
objcInit :: IsObjCObject (Id a) => Id a -> IO (Id a)

-- | <tt>&lt;math&gt; init]</tt> — allocate and default-initialize.
--   
--   Equivalent to ObjC's <tt>+new</tt>. The class is inferred from the
--   return type:
--   
--   <pre>
--   menuItem &lt;- new @NSMenuItem
--   </pre>
new :: IsObjCObject (Id a) => IO (Id a)

-- | Return a copy of an object. <tt>size</tt> is the size of the object.
object_copy :: RawId -> CSize -> IO RawId

-- | Free the memory occupied by an object. Returns nil.
object_dispose :: RawId -> IO RawId

-- | Return the class of an object.
object_getClass :: RawId -> IO Class

-- | Set the class of an object. Returns the old class.
object_setClass :: RawId -> Class -> IO Class

-- | Return whether an object is a class or metaclass.
object_isClass :: RawId -> IO Bool

-- | Return the class name of an object as a C string.
object_getClassName :: RawId -> IO CString

-- | Read the value of an instance variable.
object_getIvar :: RawId -> Ivar -> IO RawId

-- | Set the value of an instance variable (unsafe_unretained semantics for
--   unknown memory management).
object_setIvar :: RawId -> Ivar -> RawId -> IO ()

-- | Set the value of an instance variable (strong semantics for unknown
--   memory management).
object_setIvarWithStrongDefault :: RawId -> Ivar -> RawId -> IO ()

-- | Get an instance variable by name. The value is written to the output
--   pointer. Returns the <a>Ivar</a> descriptor.
object_getInstanceVariable :: RawId -> CString -> Ptr (Ptr ()) -> IO Ivar

-- | Set an instance variable by name.
object_setInstanceVariable :: RawId -> CString -> Ptr () -> IO Ivar


-- | Bindings to Objective-C method introspection functions from
--   <tt>&lt;objc/runtime.h&gt;</tt>.
module ObjC.Runtime.Method

-- | Get the selector of a method.
method_getName :: Method -> IO Sel

-- | Get the implementation (function pointer) of a method.
method_getImplementation :: Method -> IO IMP

-- | Get the type encoding string of a method.
method_getTypeEncoding :: Method -> IO CString

-- | Get the number of arguments a method accepts (including self and
--   _cmd).
method_getNumberOfArguments :: Method -> IO CUInt

-- | Copy the return type string. The caller must <tt>free</tt> the result.
method_copyReturnType :: Method -> IO CString

-- | Copy the argument type string at the given index. The caller must
--   <tt>free</tt> the result.
method_copyArgumentType :: Method -> CUInt -> IO CString

-- | Get the return type into a caller-supplied buffer.
method_getReturnType :: Method -> CString -> CSize -> IO ()

-- | Get the argument type at an index into a caller-supplied buffer.
method_getArgumentType :: Method -> CUInt -> CString -> CSize -> IO ()

-- | Set the implementation of a method. Returns the old implementation.
method_setImplementation :: Method -> IMP -> IO IMP

-- | Exchange the implementations of two methods (method swizzling).
method_exchangeImplementations :: Method -> Method -> IO ()

-- | Get a pointer to the method description struct. The pointer is owned
--   by the runtime; do not free it.
method_getDescription :: Method -> IO (Ptr ObjCMethodDescription)


-- | Type-safe Objective-C message sending.
--   
--   This module wraps the low-level <tt>libffi</tt>-based <a>MsgSend</a>
--   API with a type-safe interface driven by the phantom type parameters
--   on <a>Selector</a>. Each element in the selector's type-level argument
--   list becomes a curried function parameter, and the return type is
--   unmarshalled automatically.
--   
--   <pre>
--   -- Old style (manual libffi plumbing):
--   sendMsg obj sel (retPtr retVoid) [argPtr rawToken, argPtr rawSecret]
--   
--   -- New style (type-safe, curried):
--   sendMessage obj sel token secret
--   </pre>
--   
--   Uses the <tt>varargs</tt> library (<a>sequenceArgs</a>) to lift
--   monadic CPS brackets into variadic function argument positions,
--   keeping all pointer-backed values alive until the FFI call completes.
module ObjC.Runtime.Message

-- | Send a message to an Objective-C object with type-safe argument
--   unfolding.
--   
--   The <a>Selector</a> phantom types drive the function signature: each
--   type in the selector's argument list becomes a curried function
--   parameter.
--   
--   Uses <b>retained</b> semantics for object return values (suitable for
--   property getters, factory methods returning autoreleased objects, and
--   most other methods). For
--   <tt>init</tt>/<tt>copy</tt>/<tt>new</tt>/<tt>mutableCopy</tt> methods,
--   use <a>sendOwnedMessage</a> instead.
--   
--   <pre>
--   let sel = mkSelector "length" :: Selector '[] CULong
--   len &lt;- sendMessage nsString sel
--   
--   let sel2 = mkSelector "addProgressRangeFromStart:toEnd:"
--           :: Selector '[CDouble, CDouble] ()
--   sendMessage activity sel2 0.0 0.5
--   </pre>
sendMessage :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret recv. (IsObjCObject recv, GatherObjCArgs args, ObjCReturn ret) => recv -> Selector args ret -> args :->: IO ret

-- | Like <a>sendMessage</a>, but uses <b>owned</b> semantics for the
--   return value.
--   
--   Use for methods whose names start with <tt>init</tt>, <tt>copy</tt>,
--   <tt>new</tt>, or <tt>mutableCopy</tt> — these return a +1 reference
--   that the caller owns.
--   
--   <pre>
--   let sel = mkSelector "initWithString:"
--          :: Selector '[Id NSString] (Id NSMutableString)
--   result &lt;- sendOwnedMessage allocated sel str
--   </pre>
sendOwnedMessage :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret recv. (IsObjCObject recv, GatherObjCArgs args, ObjCReturn ret) => recv -> Selector args ret -> args :->: IO ret

-- | Send a message to an Objective-C class (class method).
--   
--   Uses retained semantics for object return values.
--   
--   <pre>
--   let sel = mkSelector "string" :: Selector '[] (Id NSString)
--   s &lt;- sendClassMessage nsStringClass sel
--   </pre>
sendClassMessage :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. (GatherObjCArgs args, ObjCReturn ret) => Class -> Selector args ret -> args :->: IO ret

-- | Like <a>sendClassMessage</a>, but uses owned semantics.
--   
--   Use for class methods like <tt>+new</tt>, <tt>+alloc</tt>.
sendOwnedClassMessage :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. (GatherObjCArgs args, ObjCReturn ret) => Class -> Selector args ret -> args :->: IO ret

-- | Types that can be marshalled as Objective-C message arguments.
--   
--   The CPS style ensures that pointer-backed values (e.g., <a>Id</a>)
--   remain alive for the duration of the FFI call via nested
--   <a>withForeignPtr</a> brackets.
--   
--   To add support for a custom type, provide an instance:
--   
--   <pre>
--   instance ObjCArgument MyStruct where
--     withObjCArg s k = <a>withStorableArg</a> s k
--   </pre>
class ObjCArgument a

-- | Marshal a value to a libffi <a>Arg</a>, keeping it alive in the
--   continuation <tt>k</tt>.
withObjCArg :: ObjCArgument a => a -> (Arg -> IO r) -> IO r

-- | Types that can be returned from Objective-C messages.
--   
--   <a>RawReturn</a> is the intermediate type that <tt>libffi</tt>
--   produces, which is then converted to the final Haskell type via
--   <a>fromRetained</a> or <a>fromOwned</a>.
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li><a>fromRetained</a> — for most methods: retains the returned
--   object (wraps a +0 / autoreleased reference).</li>
--   <li><a>fromOwned</a> — for
--   <tt>init</tt>/<tt>copy</tt>/<tt>new</tt>/<tt>mutableCopy</tt> methods:
--   takes ownership of a +1 reference without an extra retain.</li>
--   </ul>
--   
--   For non-object types both methods are identical.
class ObjCReturn a where {
    
    -- | The raw type returned by <tt>libffi</tt>.
    type RawReturn a;
}

-- | The <tt>libffi</tt> return type descriptor.
objcRetType :: ObjCReturn a => RetType (RawReturn a)

-- | Which <tt>objc_msgSend</tt> variant to use.
msgSendVariant :: ObjCReturn a => MsgSendVariant

-- | Convert from the raw return value with <b>retained</b> semantics.
fromRetained :: ObjCReturn a => RawReturn a -> IO a

-- | Convert from the raw return value with <b>owned</b> semantics.
fromOwned :: ObjCReturn a => RawReturn a -> IO a

-- | Which <tt>objc_msgSend</tt> variant to use for a given return type.
--   
--   On ARM64 all three are identical, but on x86_64 floating-point and
--   struct returns require dedicated trampolines.
data MsgSendVariant

-- | Standard <tt>objc_msgSend</tt>
MsgSendNormal :: MsgSendVariant

-- | <tt>objc_msgSend_fpret</tt> (x86_64 float/double returns)
MsgSendFpret :: MsgSendVariant

-- | <tt>objc_msgSend_stret</tt> (x86_64 large-struct returns)
MsgSendStret :: MsgSendVariant

-- | Inductively gathers <a>ObjCArgument</a> values into a <tt>libffi</tt>
--   <a>Arg</a> list, nesting CPS brackets so that every pointer-backed
--   value remains alive when <a>callFFI</a> executes.
--   
--   Uses <a>sequenceArgs</a> from <tt>varargs</tt> to lift the monadic CPS
--   result back into a variadic function at each inductive step.
class GatherObjCArgs (args :: [Type])
gatherObjCArgs :: GatherObjCArgs args => ([Arg] -> [Arg]) -> ([Arg] -> IO r) -> args :->: IO r
instance (ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument arg, ObjC.Runtime.Message.GatherObjCArgs rest, VarArgs.VarArgs rest) => ObjC.Runtime.Message.GatherObjCArgs (arg : rest)
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.GatherObjCArgs '[]
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument GHC.Internal.Types.Bool
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CChar
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CDouble
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CFloat
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CInt
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CLong
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CSChar
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CShort
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CUChar
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CUInt
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CULong
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CUShort
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument ObjC.Runtime.Types.Class
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument a => ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument (ObjC.Runtime.Types.Const a)
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument (ObjC.Runtime.Types.Id a)
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument ObjC.Runtime.Types.ObjCBool
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument (GHC.Internal.Ptr.Ptr a)
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument ObjC.Runtime.Types.RawId
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument (ObjC.Runtime.Types.Selector args ret)
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument a => ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCArgument (ObjC.Runtime.Types.Volatile a)
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn GHC.Internal.Types.Bool
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CChar
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CDouble
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CFloat
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CInt
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CLong
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CSChar
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CShort
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CUChar
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CUInt
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CULong
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn GHC.Internal.Foreign.C.Types.CUShort
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn ObjC.Runtime.Types.Class
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn a => ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn (ObjC.Runtime.Types.Const a)
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn (ObjC.Runtime.Types.Id a)
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn GHC.Internal.Int.Int8
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn ObjC.Runtime.Types.ObjCBool
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn (GHC.Internal.Ptr.Ptr a)
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn ObjC.Runtime.Types.RawId
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn (ObjC.Runtime.Types.Selector args ret)
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn ()
instance ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn a => ObjC.Runtime.Message.ObjCReturn (ObjC.Runtime.Types.Volatile a)


-- | Bindings to Objective-C instance variable introspection functions from
--   <tt>&lt;objc/runtime.h&gt;</tt>.
module ObjC.Runtime.Ivar

-- | Get the name of an instance variable.
ivar_getName :: Ivar -> IO CString

-- | Get the type encoding of an instance variable.
ivar_getTypeEncoding :: Ivar -> IO CString

-- | Get the byte offset of an instance variable from the start of the
--   object.
ivar_getOffset :: Ivar -> IO CPtrdiff


-- | Bindings for dynamically creating new Objective-C classes at runtime.
module ObjC.Runtime.ClassBuilder

-- | Allocate a new class/metaclass pair. <tt>superclass</tt> is the
--   superclass, <tt>name</tt> is the class name, and <tt>extraBytes</tt>
--   is usually 0. Between this call and <a>objc_registerClassPair</a>, you
--   may add ivars and methods.
objc_allocateClassPair :: Class -> CString -> CSize -> IO Class

-- | Register a class pair previously created with
--   <a>objc_allocateClassPair</a>. After registration, the class is ready
--   to use.
objc_registerClassPair :: Class -> IO ()

-- | Destroy a class pair created with <a>objc_allocateClassPair</a>. Do
--   not call this on classes that have existing instances.
objc_disposeClassPair :: Class -> IO ()


-- | Bindings to Objective-C class and class-lookup functions from
--   <tt>&lt;objc/runtime.h&gt;</tt>.
module ObjC.Runtime.Class

-- | Look up a class by name. Returns <a>nilClass</a> if not found.
objc_getClass :: CString -> IO Class

-- | Look up a metaclass by name.
objc_getMetaClass :: CString -> IO Class

-- | Look up a class by name. Unlike <a>objc_getClass</a>, does not call
--   the class handler callback if the class is not found.
objc_lookUpClass :: CString -> IO Class

-- | Like <a>objc_getClass</a> but aborts the process if the class is not
--   found.
objc_getRequiredClass :: CString -> IO Class

-- | Get the total number of registered classes and optionally fill a
--   buffer.
objc_getClassList :: Ptr Class -> CInt -> IO CInt

-- | Copy the list of all registered classes. The returned array must be
--   freed with <a>free</a>. The count is written to the output parameter.
objc_copyClassList :: Ptr CUInt -> IO (Ptr Class)

-- | Get the name of a class as a C string.
class_getName :: Class -> IO CString

-- | Get the superclass of a class. Returns <a>nilClass</a> for root
--   classes.
class_getSuperclass :: Class -> IO Class

-- | Test whether a class is a metaclass.
class_isMetaClass :: Class -> IO Bool

-- | Get the size in bytes of instances of a class.
class_getInstanceSize :: Class -> IO CSize

-- | Get the version of a class definition.
class_getVersion :: Class -> IO CInt

-- | Set the version of a class definition.
class_setVersion :: Class -> CInt -> IO ()

-- | Test whether instances of a class respond to a selector.
class_respondsToSelector :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. Class -> Selector args ret -> IO Bool
class_getInstanceVariable :: Class -> CString -> IO Ivar
class_getClassVariable :: Class -> CString -> IO Ivar

-- | Copy the list of instance variables declared by a class. Returns the
--   ivars and their count. The caller does NOT need to free the returned
--   list (it is copied into a Haskell list).
class_copyIvarList :: Class -> IO [Ivar]
class_getInstanceMethod :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. Class -> Selector args ret -> IO Method
class_getClassMethod :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. Class -> Selector args ret -> IO Method

-- | Copy the list of instance methods implemented directly by a class.
class_copyMethodList :: Class -> IO [Method]

-- | Get the IMP for a given selector on a class.
class_getMethodImplementation :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. Class -> Selector args ret -> IO IMP

-- | Add a method to a class. Returns <a>True</a> if successful.
class_addMethod :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. Class -> Selector args ret -> IMP -> CString -> IO Bool

-- | Replace the implementation of a method. Returns the old IMP.
class_replaceMethod :: forall (args :: [Type]) ret. Class -> Selector args ret -> IMP -> CString -> IO IMP

-- | Test whether a class conforms to a protocol.
class_conformsToProtocol :: Class -> Protocol -> IO Bool

-- | Copy the list of protocols adopted by a class.
class_copyProtocolList :: Class -> IO [Protocol]

-- | Add a protocol to a class. Returns <a>True</a> if successful.
class_addProtocol :: Class -> Protocol -> IO Bool

-- | Get a property by name.
class_getProperty :: Class -> CString -> IO ObjCProperty

-- | Copy the list of properties declared by a class.
class_copyPropertyList :: Class -> IO [ObjCProperty]

-- | Add a property to a class.
class_addProperty :: Class -> CString -> Ptr ObjCPropertyAttribute -> CUInt -> IO Bool

-- | Replace a property on a class.
class_replaceProperty :: Class -> CString -> Ptr ObjCPropertyAttribute -> CUInt -> IO ()

-- | Add an instance variable to a class being constructed (between
--   <tt>objc_allocateClassPair</tt> and <tt>objc_registerClassPair</tt>).
class_addIvar :: Class -> CString -> CSize -> Word8 -> CString -> IO Bool
class_getIvarLayout :: Class -> IO (Ptr Word8)
class_setIvarLayout :: Class -> Ptr Word8 -> IO ()
class_getWeakIvarLayout :: Class -> IO (Ptr Word8)
class_setWeakIvarLayout :: Class -> Ptr Word8 -> IO ()

-- | Create a new instance of a class, allocating memory in the default
--   malloc zone. <tt>extraBytes</tt> are for indexed ivars.
class_createInstance :: Class -> CSize -> IO RawId

-- | Look up a class by Haskell <a>String</a>. Returns <a>Nothing</a> if
--   not registered.
getClass :: String -> IO (Maybe Class)

-- | Look up a class by Haskell <a>String</a>. Throws an <a>error</a> if
--   the class is not registered with the Objective-C runtime.
getRequiredClass :: String -> IO Class

-- | Get the name of a class as a Haskell <a>String</a>.
className :: Class -> IO String


-- | Pure NSString construction.
--   
--   This module provides <a>pureNSString</a>, which creates an
--   <tt>NSString</tt> from a Haskell <a>String</a> purely (outside of
--   <a>IO</a>). This is safe because:
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li><tt>NSString</tt> is immutable — the same input always produces a
--   semantically identical object.</li>
--   <li>The result is retained with a release finalizer on the
--   <tt>ForeignPtr</tt>, ensuring deterministic cleanup by the Haskell
--   GC.</li>
--   </ul>
module ObjC.Runtime.NSString

-- | Create an <tt>NSString</tt> from a Haskell <a>String</a>, purely.
--   
--   The Haskell <a>String</a> is encoded as UTF-8 and passed to
--   <tt>+[NSString stringWithUTF8String:]</tt>.
--   
--   Safe because NSString is immutable and construction is deterministic.
--   The result is retained with a release finalizer on the
--   <tt>ForeignPtr</tt>.
--   
--   <pre>
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; :set -XOverloadedStrings
--   
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; let s = pureNSString "hello"
--   </pre>
pureNSString :: String -> Id a


-- | Infrastructure for dynamically defined Objective-C classes with
--   Haskell-backed method implementations.
--   
--   Each instance of a dynamic class carries a <i>vtable</i> — a C array
--   of function pointers stored in an ivar called <tt>_hs_vtable</tt>. The
--   class's IMP stubs (registered at class-creation time) read the vtable
--   from <tt>self</tt> and dispatch through the appropriate slot.
--   
--   This module provides the low-level helpers. Most users should use the
--   Template Haskell API in <a>ObjC.Runtime.TH</a> instead.
module ObjC.Runtime.DynClass

-- | Add the <tt>_hs_vtable</tt> ivar to a class being constructed (between
--   <tt>objc_allocateClassPair</tt> and <tt>objc_registerClassPair</tt>).
--   
--   The ivar is a single pointer (<tt>^v</tt> type encoding) that will
--   hold the address of a heap-allocated array of <a>FunPtr</a>s.
addVtableIvar :: Class -> IO ()

-- | Read the vtable pointer from an instance's <tt>_hs_vtable</tt> ivar.
--   
--   The returned pointer points to a C array of <tt>void *</tt> slots,
--   each holding a <a>FunPtr</a> (cast to <tt>Ptr ()</tt>).
--   
--   Takes a raw <tt>Ptr ObjCObject</tt> (as received by an IMP) rather
--   than <a>RawId</a> to avoid unnecessary wrapping in dispatch stubs.
readVtable :: Ptr ObjCObject -> IO (Ptr (Ptr ()))

-- | Write the vtable pointer into an instance's <tt>_hs_vtable</tt> ivar.
writeVtable :: RawId -> Ptr (Ptr ()) -> IO ()

-- | Register a <tt>dealloc</tt> method on a class under construction that
--   frees the vtable and its <a>FunPtr</a> slots, then calls <tt>[super
--   dealloc]</tt>.
--   
--   Must be called between <tt>objc_allocateClassPair</tt> and
--   <tt>objc_registerClassPair</tt>, after <a>addVtableIvar</a>.
--   
--   <tt>nSlots</tt> is the number of instance method slots in the vtable
--   (i.e., the number of <a>FunPtr</a>s that were poked into each
--   instance's vtable array).
addDeallocHandler :: Class -> Int -> IO ()

-- | Add a method to a class under construction.
--   
--   <pre>
--   addObjCMethod cls "increment:" "v@:@" funPtr
--   </pre>
--   
--   This is a convenience wrapper around <a>class_addMethod</a> that takes
--   Haskell <a>String</a>s for the selector and type encoding.
addObjCMethod :: Class -> String -> String -> FunPtr a -> IO ()

-- | Cast any <a>FunPtr</a> to <a>IMP</a>. The Objective-C runtime stores
--   all method implementations as <a>IMP</a> regardless of the actual
--   signature; the correct calling convention is ensured by the type
--   encoding.
castIMP :: FunPtr a -> IMP


-- | Template Haskell API for defining Objective-C classes backed by
--   Haskell method implementations.
--   
--   <h1>Usage</h1>
--   
--   At the splice site, you must have these imports:
--   
--   <pre>
--   import ObjC.Runtime
--   import ObjC.Runtime.DynClass
--   import ObjC.Runtime.TH
--   import Foreign.Ptr
--   import Foreign.Marshal.Array (mallocArray, peekElemOff, pokeElemOff)
--   import Foreign.C.Types
--   import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
--   </pre>
--   
--   Then at top level:
--   
--   <pre>
--   $(defineClass "CounterTarget" "NSObject" $ do
--     instanceMethod "increment:" [t| RawId -&gt; IO () |]
--     instanceMethod "decrement:" [t| RawId -&gt; IO () |]
--   )
--   </pre>
--   
--   This generates a record type <tt>CounterTargetImpl</tt>, a class CAF
--   <tt>counterTargetClass</tt>, and a constructor
--   <tt>newCounterTarget</tt>.
module ObjC.Runtime.TH

-- | Generate all declarations for a Haskell-backed Objective-C class.
defineClass :: String -> String -> ClassDef () -> Q [Dec]

-- | Declare a class method (shared across all instances).
classMethod :: String -> Q Type -> ClassDef ()

-- | Declare an instance method (per-instance implementation).
instanceMethod :: String -> Q Type -> ClassDef ()

-- | Monadic builder for describing the methods of a class.
data ClassDef a
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Applicative ObjC.Runtime.TH.ClassDef
instance GHC.Internal.Classes.Eq ObjC.Runtime.TH.MethodKind
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Functor ObjC.Runtime.TH.ClassDef
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Monad ObjC.Runtime.TH.ClassDef
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show ObjC.Runtime.TH.MethodKind


-- | StablePtr-in-ivar infrastructure for Haskell-backed ObjC classes.
--   
--   This module provides an alternative to the per-instance vtable
--   approach in <a>ObjC.Runtime.DynClass</a>. Instead of allocating a C
--   array of <tt>FunPtr</tt>s per instance, a single <tt>StablePtr</tt> to
--   an arbitrary Haskell value is stored in the instance's
--   <tt>_hs_vtable</tt> ivar.
--   
--   IMP stubs (registered at class-creation time) read the
--   <tt>StablePtr</tt> from <tt>self</tt>, deref it to recover the Haskell
--   value, and dispatch directly — no <tt>foreign import ccall
--   "dynamic"</tt> boundary crossing.
--   
--   Used by <a>ObjC.Runtime.ActionTarget</a>,
--   <a>ObjC.Runtime.DelegateProxy</a>, and (future) codegen'd
--   delegate/subclass modules.
module ObjC.Runtime.StableIvar

-- | Add the <tt>_hs_vtable</tt> ivar to a class being constructed.
--   
--   Must be called between <tt>objc_allocateClassPair</tt> and
--   <tt>objc_registerClassPair</tt>. The ivar is a single pointer that
--   will hold a <tt>StablePtr</tt> (cast to <tt>Ptr ()</tt>).
addHsDataIvar :: Class -> IO ()

-- | Store a <tt>StablePtr</tt> in an instance's ivar.
writeHsData :: RawId -> StablePtr a -> IO ()

-- | Read the <tt>StablePtr</tt> from an instance's ivar.
--   
--   Takes a raw <tt>Ptr ObjCObject</tt> (as received by an IMP stub) to
--   avoid wrapping in the hot dispatch path.
readHsData :: Ptr ObjCObject -> IO (StablePtr a)

-- | Register a <tt>dealloc</tt> method that frees the instance's
--   <tt>StablePtr</tt> and calls <tt>[super dealloc]</tt>.
--   
--   Must be called between <tt>objc_allocateClassPair</tt> and
--   <tt>objc_registerClassPair</tt>, after <a>addHsDataIvar</a>.
addStablePtrDeallocHandler :: Class -> IO ()

-- | Add a method to a class under construction.
--   
--   <pre>
--   addObjCMethod cls "increment:" "v@:@" funPtr
--   </pre>
--   
--   This is a convenience wrapper around <a>class_addMethod</a> that takes
--   Haskell <a>String</a>s for the selector and type encoding.
addObjCMethod :: Class -> String -> String -> FunPtr a -> IO ()

-- | Cast any <a>FunPtr</a> to <a>IMP</a>. The Objective-C runtime stores
--   all method implementations as <a>IMP</a> regardless of the actual
--   signature; the correct calling convention is ensured by the type
--   encoding.
castIMP :: FunPtr a -> IMP


-- | Compose multiple delegate objects into a single ObjC object via
--   message forwarding.
--   
--   When an ObjC API requires the <i>same</i> object to serve as both
--   delegate and data source (or conform to multiple protocols), this
--   module lets you combine per-protocol delegate objects without Template
--   Haskell.
--   
--   <h1>How It Works</h1>
--   
--   The proxy class overrides <tt>forwardingTargetForSelector:</tt> — the
--   ObjC runtime calls this before raising
--   <tt>doesNotRecognizeSelector:</tt> when a message arrives that the
--   proxy doesn't directly implement. The override iterates through the
--   delegate list and returns the first one that responds, causing the
--   runtime to re-dispatch the message to that delegate. No
--   <tt>NSInvocation</tt> boxing is involved; this is the fast forwarding
--   path.
--   
--   <h1>Usage</h1>
--   
--   <pre>
--   dataSource &lt;- newNSTableViewDataSource $ ...
--   delegate   &lt;- newNSTableViewDelegate $ ...
--   combined   &lt;- newDelegateProxy [dataSource, delegate]
--   
--   -- Set <tt>combined</tt> as both delegate and dataSource on the table view.
--   </pre>
--   
--   When separate objects work fine (most cases), prefer that over a proxy
--   — it's simpler and avoids the extra forwarding hop.
module ObjC.Runtime.DelegateProxy

-- | Create a proxy that forwards messages to the first delegate that
--   responds to each selector.
--   
--   The delegates are tried in order, so earlier entries take priority
--   when multiple delegates respond to the same selector.
newDelegateProxy :: [RawId] -> IO RawId


-- | Safe runtime-checked downcasting for phantom-typed ObjC pointers.
--   
--   Upcasting (e.g., <tt>Id NSMutableString</tt> -&gt; <tt>Id
--   NSString</tt>) is handled at compile time via the <tt>IsXxx</tt> type
--   class hierarchy. Downcasting requires a runtime check because the
--   Haskell type system cannot prove that a given <tt>Id NSString</tt> is
--   actually an <tt>Id NSMutableString</tt>.
--   
--   This module provides <a>safeCast</a>, which uses Objective-C's
--   <tt>isKindOfClass:</tt> message to perform the check, returning
--   <a>Nothing</a> if the object is not an instance of (or a subclass of)
--   the target class.
module ObjC.Runtime.Cast

-- | Safe runtime-checked downcast using Objective-C's
--   <tt>isKindOfClass:</tt>.
--   
--   Returns <a>Just</a> the object with a refined type if the object is an
--   instance of the target class (or any of its subclasses), or
--   <a>Nothing</a> otherwise.
--   
--   This is a zero-cost re-tag — no retain/release is performed.
--   
--   <pre>
--   -- Attempt to downcast an Id NSString to Id NSMutableString:
--   result &lt;- safeCast @NSMutableString someString
--   case result of
--     Just mutable -&gt; ...   -- it was mutable
--     Nothing      -&gt; ...   -- it was not
--   </pre>
safeCast :: forall b a. (IsObjCObject (Id a), IsObjCObject (Id b)) => Id a -> IO (Maybe (Id b))


-- | Create Objective-C blocks from Haskell functions.
--   
--   Objective-C blocks are callable objects used pervasively as callbacks,
--   completion handlers, and enumeration bodies. This module lets you wrap
--   a Haskell closure into a heap-allocated block that can be passed to
--   any Objective-C API expecting a block parameter.
--   
--   <h1>Supported block signatures</h1>
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li><tt>void (^)(void)</tt> — <a>withVoidBlock</a> /
--   <a>newVoidBlock</a></li>
--   <li><tt>void (^)(id)</tt> — <a>withIdBlock</a> /
--   <a>newIdBlock</a></li>
--   </ul>
--   
--   For other signatures, use <a>newBlock</a> directly with your own
--   <tt>foreign import ccall "wrapper"</tt> declaration.
--   
--   <h1>Example</h1>
--   
--   <pre>
--   -- Fire a timer that prints every second:
--   withVoidBlock (putStrLn "tick") $ \block -&gt;
--     NSTimer.scheduledTimerWithTimeInterval_repeats_block 1.0 True block
--   </pre>
module ObjC.Runtime.Block

-- | Bracket-style: create a <tt>void (^)(void)</tt> block, pass it to the
--   continuation, and free it afterwards.
withVoidBlock :: IO () -> (RawId -> IO a) -> IO a

-- | Bracket-style: create a <tt>void (^)(id)</tt> block, pass it to the
--   continuation, and free it afterwards.
withIdBlock :: (RawId -> IO ()) -> (RawId -> IO a) -> IO a

-- | Create a <tt>void (^)(void)</tt> block from a Haskell <a>IO</a>
--   action.
newVoidBlock :: IO () -> IO RawId

-- | Create a <tt>void (^)(id)</tt> block from a Haskell function.
newIdBlock :: (RawId -> IO ()) -> IO RawId

-- | Release a block created by <a>newBlock</a>, <a>newVoidBlock</a>, or
--   <a>newIdBlock</a>.
freeBlock :: RawId -> IO ()

-- | Create a block from an already-wrapped invoke <a>FunPtr</a>.
--   
--   The <a>FunPtr</a> must point to a function whose first argument is
--   <tt>Ptr ()</tt> (the block pointer itself). Remaining arguments must
--   match the block's type signature.
--   
--   The returned <a>RawId</a> is a heap-allocated block. Call
--   <a>freeBlock</a> when done (or use one of the bracket-style helpers).
newBlock :: FunPtr a -> IO RawId


-- | Bindings to Objective-C associated object functions from
--   <tt>&lt;objc/runtime.h&gt;</tt>.
module ObjC.Runtime.Association

-- | Set an associated value on an object for a given key and policy. The
--   key is typically the address of a static variable.
objc_setAssociatedObject :: RawId -> Ptr () -> RawId -> ObjCAssociationPolicy -> IO ()

-- | Get the associated value for a given key.
objc_getAssociatedObject :: RawId -> Ptr () -> IO RawId

-- | Remove all associated objects from an object. This is mainly for use
--   by the runtime; you typically should not call this.
objc_removeAssociatedObjects :: RawId -> IO ()


-- | Create ObjC objects that respond to target/action selectors, backed by
--   Haskell closures. No Template Haskell required.
--   
--   Every Cocoa target/action method has the same C signature:
--   <tt>-(void)action:(id)sender</tt> (type encoding <tt>v@:@</tt>). This
--   means a single <tt>foreign import ccall "wrapper"</tt> covers all
--   action methods.
--   
--   The <a>ActionHandler</a> GADT pairs a typed <a>Selector</a> with a
--   handler whose argument types are driven by the selector's phantom
--   parameters. The <a>(:=)</a> constructor is existentially quantified so
--   handlers of different types can appear in the same list.
--   
--   <h1>Usage</h1>
--   
--   <pre>
--   import ObjC.Runtime
--   import ObjC.Runtime.ActionTarget
--   
--   -- Action that ignores the sender (Sel = Selector '[] ())
--   addItemSel :: Sel
--   addItemSel = mkSelector "addItem:"
--   
--   -- Action that receives a typed sender
--   toggleSel :: Selector '[Id NSView] ()
--   toggleSel = mkSelector "toggle:"
--   
--   target &lt;- newActionTarget
--     [ addItemSel := do
--         putStrLn "Add item!"
--     , toggleSel := \sender -&gt; do
--         rowIdx &lt;- TV.rowForView tableView sender
--         ...
--     ]
--   Ctrl.setTarget button target
--   Ctrl.setAction button (asSel addItemSel)
--   </pre>
module ObjC.Runtime.ActionTarget

-- | An existentially quantified action handler that pairs a typed
--   <a>Selector</a> with a handler function whose arguments match the
--   selector's phantom type parameters.
--   
--   Use the <a>(:=)</a> constructor as an infix operator:
--   
--   <pre>
--   mySel := \sender -&gt; putStrLn "clicked"
--   </pre>
data ActionHandler
[:=] :: forall (args :: [Type]). InvokeAction args => Selector args () -> (args :->: IO ()) -> ActionHandler

-- | Decode a single Objective-C argument from a raw pointer.
--   
--   Instances control how the raw <tt>id</tt> pointer delivered by the
--   ObjC runtime is presented to the Haskell handler.
class DecodeActionArg a
decodeActionArg :: DecodeActionArg a => Ptr ObjCObject -> IO a

-- | Convert a typed handler (whose shape is driven by the selector's
--   phantom type-level argument list) into the uniform representation used
--   internally by the action target infrastructure.
--   
--   The <tt>[Ptr ObjCObject]</tt> list contains the raw arguments
--   delivered by the ObjC IMP stub (currently just the sender for the
--   standard target/action pattern <tt>v@:@</tt>).
class InvokeAction (args :: [Type])
invokeAction :: InvokeAction args => (args :->: IO ()) -> [Ptr ObjCObject] -> IO ()

-- | Create an ObjC object that responds to the given action selectors.
--   
--   Each <a>ActionHandler</a> pairs a typed selector with a matching
--   Haskell handler. The returned <a>RawId</a> can be set as a control's
--   target.
--   
--   Multiple calls with the same set of selectors (regardless of order)
--   share a single ObjC class registration.
newActionTarget :: [ActionHandler] -> IO RawId
instance ObjC.Runtime.ActionTarget.DecodeActionArg (ObjC.Runtime.Types.Id a)
instance ObjC.Runtime.ActionTarget.DecodeActionArg ObjC.Runtime.Types.RawId
instance ObjC.Runtime.ActionTarget.DecodeActionArg a => ObjC.Runtime.ActionTarget.InvokeAction '[a]
instance (ObjC.Runtime.ActionTarget.DecodeActionArg a, ObjC.Runtime.ActionTarget.DecodeActionArg b) => ObjC.Runtime.ActionTarget.InvokeAction '[a, b]
instance ObjC.Runtime.ActionTarget.InvokeAction '[]


-- | Comprehensive Haskell bindings to the Objective-C runtime
--   (<tt>libobjc</tt>).
--   
--   This module re-exports everything you need to interact with the
--   Objective-C runtime: type definitions, class/object introspection,
--   dynamic message sending (via <tt>libffi</tt>), framework loading,
--   autorelease pool management, and runtime class construction.
--   
--   <h1>Quick start</h1>
--   
--   <pre>
--   import ObjC.Runtime
--   import Foreign.LibFFI
--   import Foreign.C.String
--   
--   main :: IO ()
--   main = withAutoreleasePool $ do
--     -- Get the NSString class
--     nsCls &lt;- getRequiredClass "NSString"
--   
--     -- Register selectors
--     allocSel  &lt;- mkSelector "alloc"
--     initSel   &lt;- mkSelector "initWithUTF8String:"
--     lenSel    &lt;- mkSelector "length"
--   
--     -- Send messages
--     raw   &lt;- sendClassMsg nsCls allocSel (retPtr retVoid) []
--     let obj = Id (castPtr raw)  -- uninitialized NSString
--     -- ... etc
--   </pre>
module ObjC.Runtime
